---
name: Feature or implementation task
about: Track an approved service feature with acceptance and evidence
title: "[API/MOB/ADM/WEB-xxx] "
---
## Stable ID, service, milestone and priority
Use an existing README ID; new scope needs approval. State accountable assignee or Unassigned.

## Outcome and scope
Define the user/operator outcome, exclusions, parent/child links and dependencies.

## Acceptance
Cover success, authorisation failures, duplicate/concurrent requests, provider ambiguity and recovery where applicable.

## Evidence and status
Record implementation state, verification state, provider acceptance and release independently. Link specifications, source, tests, commands/results, PR/commit and visual evidence. Record blocker and next action.

## Documentation delivery
Update service README, root summary, generated register, relevant contracts and runbooks together. No customer data or secrets.
